hard_case: Measured defect (#7598): ripr reported the related test's oracle `assert_eq!(score(2) != 0, true)` as exact_value / strong, because an `assert_eq!` credited exact equality whatever its operands. RIPR-SPEC-0231 rule 1 (example 31): comparing the inequality `score(2) != 0` with `true` asserts only that inequality, so it pins no value. The line verdict stays gap; the overclaim showed in the related test's reported oracle. Since #7598's fix ripr reports relational_check / weak.
